snippet.title: Granny Chapter two R͙̈͠e̴̺̝ͣ̎w͔̭͚͐̓ơ̹͉r̷̫̉͊k͙̻̮̇e̺̬͌͞d͖̖ͫ (Recreated) (Trailer) (Flash warning)
snippet.description:
Original game creator: @DVloper1
Original game trailer: https://youtu.be/lWmxfmOg8Mc?si=wao9geifpbOZDRMQ

Download reworked here (Gamejolt): https://gamejolt.com/games/GCHTR/973779
Or you can download it here (Itch.io): https://redern-games.itch.io/granny-2-reworked

Granny chapter two is my favorite part of the Granny game trilogy. One day I played Graveyard Shift at Freddy's and thought, what if I made something similar, but with Granny? I already had a remake of Granny 2, which I abandoned, but I decided to give that project a second wind, and that’s how this version of Granny 2 Reworked came about. And I was also inspired by the Puppet Combo games—I think that’s obvious.

Will you be able to avoid the fate of being dismembered or eaten alive and escape to freedom?
